text:
anya: quick flag  staging linkcheck failed on a few code snippets that include triple backticks followed by a language tag with parentheses, e.g. ```bash (example)

docs-bot: link-checker: 2 broken fragments found. preview CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/8234

mo: saw this before after the markdown-processor upgrade. the fence parser treats the paren as part of the slug for the generated heading id, which breaks links that expect the old slug.

sam: minimal fixes: either remove the paren in the code fence language tag or explicitly set heading ids. example quick patch:
```
### Example usage {#example-usage}
```

anya: i'll open a tiny PR to normalize the three affected snippets and add explicit ids to the headings they reference. will run `npx linkinator .` locally.

sam: thanks. also file a tiny note in docs/STYLE.md so future writers avoid parentheses in fence tags.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120  preview: https://deploy-preview-4120--docs.redwood.ai/examples/usage (linkcheck passed).

mo: lgtm, merging after CI. nice catch.
